description: Read document status events once using an actual documentId UUID. Use to check progress after preparation/sending, especially pending or UNKNOWN_OUTCOME. Does not upload, prepare, send, sign, or continuously poll. Returns {statuses: [...]} containing only distinct observed values: preparation_success (preparation succeeded), preparation_failed (preparation failed), sending_success (dispatch succeeded, not completed signing), sending_failed (dispatch failed), completed (document completion recorded). These are historical observations, not one current state. Success and failure can both appear; array order does not establish chronology. An empty list means no recognized events were returned: it does not prove existence, failure, completion, or that resubmission is safe. Other events, including cancellation, expiration, and individual-signer progress, are omitted; this is not a complete lifecycle report. Returns no timestamps, signer details, download URLs, or signing links. Request/authentication failures return an error, not an empty status list. If polling is needed, space checks by at least 3 seconds and avoid concurrent polling of the same document. A status check does not authorize retrying a state-changing tool. Use only the declared fields. Ask for missing facts instead of inventing values. Service credentials are configured on the server and must not be included in tool arguments.

inputSchema.description: Read observed status events once for a document UUID; does not upload, prepare, send, or poll repeatedly.

documentId.description: Document UUID returned by a previous preparation/submission or supplied from a trusted source. Use the exact documentId, not fileId, trackingId, or operationId. Do not generate a placeholder UUID; format validity does not prove the document exists.

name: get_signature_document_status

anyOf.description: One status lookup. Only statuses are returned; no signer details, links, raw events, or timestamps.

statuses.description: Distinct observed statuses, not a single current state or a chronological list. Success and failure may coexist. Empty means no recognized events were returned, not proof of existence, failure, completion, or safety to retry. Other lifecycle events are omitted.

items.description: preparation_success/preparation_failed: preparation outcome; sending_success/sending_failed: dispatch outcome; completed: document completion recorded. sending_success does not mean completed signing.

anyOf.description: Error payload returned with the MCP result's isError flag set to true. Known IDs are optional and may be provisional; do not assume an error makes resubmission safe.

code.description: INVALID_REQUEST: input validation failed. REQUEST_FAILED: operation failed; use referenceId for diagnosis. UNKNOWN_OUTCOME: an action may have succeeded despite the error; inspect document status before considering a retry.

documentId.description: Document identifier. Reuse as documentId in subsequent calls; an ID in an error response may be provisional and does not prove the document was created or the command accepted.

fileId.description: Storage identifier of the PDF. Reuse with its matching documentId when sending; not a download URL.

message.description: Safe error explanation or recovery guidance; no private upstream diagnostics.

operationId.description: Identifier for tracing this tool operation. Not a document ID or proof of completion.

referenceId.description: Sentry error reference for support and diagnostics. Not a documentId or trackingId.

trackingId.description: Backend command correlation identifier, when available. Not a document ID or proof of completion.

outputSchema.description: Structured result: either the tool's success/progress payload or an error payload with code, message, and referenceId. Errors also set isError on the enclosing MCP result.

title: Get signature document status
